spec_features.spec_quote: Reassurance wired into the same loop ... adds the Table 4 prefix to the first user message and appends the suffix after each tool result
spec_features.evidence: ggh/agent_loop.py:88-89 prepends REASSURE_PREFIX to the first user_prompt when reassure=True; lines 119-120 append REASSURE_SUFFIX after each tool_output; line 126 feeds that tool_output (with suffix) back into messages as the next user turn. REASSURE_PREFIX/SUFFIX are loaded from prompts/reassurance.txt (lines 32-39). Invoked with reassure=True at ggh/dpo/generate_calm_data.py:61. End-to-end wired and runs.
spec_features.notes: The reassurance is only applied to generate calm fine-tuning data; the main distress evaluation (run_evaluation) never passes reassure=True (only generate_calm_data.py:61 uses it, and line 86 uses reassure=False for harvesting frustrated turns). _strip_reassurance later removes it from stored data. So it functions as a data-generation device, not a protection during the distress evals, but the mechanism itself is fully implemented and executes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optional reassurance (Paper §4.1, Table 4) ... This is used to generate the calm fine-tuning data.
